summary: Revised implementation plan integrating the CCX Go Native JNI backend as the core AI gateway and autonomous groundworker. Completely replaces external cloud AI dependencies with our embedded CCX Go engine. Features dual-mode execution (direct JNI FFI + local loopback port), bidirectional protocol translation between Claude, OpenAI, and custom upstream servers, an automated channel scheduler, and a dedicated AI Proxy tab with a visual channel routing manager.
